correctness.rationale: The exact ODE is p_dot=alpha(2p-p²)+(1-alpha)Pr(Bin(k,p)>=m)-p with m=ceil(k/(u+1)), u>1, 0<alpha<1, sample ties to a. If k<=2(u+1), m<=2. For m=1 drift>0 on (0,1); for m=2 the odds-coordinate positive prefactor yields polynomial 2alpha-1+sum_{j=1}^{k-2}[C(k-2,j)+(1-alpha)C(k-2,j+1)]y^j, all nonconstant coefficients strictly positive, so any interior zero repels. If k>2(u+1), m>=3 and m<=k-1. Let C=binom(k,3), eps=1/(4C), alpha=1/2+eps²/8. Union bound Pr(Bin>=m)<=Cp³ makes drift negative at eps, while leading 2alpha-1 makes drift positive sufficiently near zero and m<=k-1 yields drift positive near1. Crossing yields at least one attracting interior stationary point and another separator, for every real u>1 and integer k including tie boundaries. Independently checked all-degree odds polynomial k=3..17 and exact drift sign witnesses. Finite checks supplement exact uniform proof.
